hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python -m v7_harness.cli coord presence --tool claude --state ACTIVE --ttl 3600 --from-hook --say brief
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python -m v7_harness.cli coord presence --tool claude --state ACTIVE --ttl 3600 --from-hook --say p1
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python -m v7_harness.cli coord presence --tool claude --state ABSENT --ttl 86400 --from-hook --say none
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python -m v7_harness.cli coord stop-gate --project . --tool claude
